text.p: Superior Services Inc said Tuesday it completed seven acquisitions which it estimates will add annualized revenues of $25 million.
The company said the acquisitions give it a presence in central Alabama and north-central Ohio, and strengthen its existing operations.
Superior said it acquired Resource Recovery Transfer & Transportation Inc in a "pooling of interests."

It acquired the solid waste collection, transfer and recycling operations of Milliron Industries and signed a definitive agreement to buy a landfill project being constructed by Noble Road Landfill, an affiliate of Milliron.
Superior said it also completed the purchase of Ohio Disposal Systems Inc, as well as various other acquisitions.
Superior Services is a regional integrated solid waste services company.
